Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Week 0 (today): Confirm billing entity and PO approver (Nimbus) + send initial SOW draft (Redwood)
- Week 1: Legal redlines turnaround (Redwood + Nimbus legal) — target 3 business days if redlines limited to standard terms
- Week 2: AWS Marketplace private offer submission (Redwood to create offer; Nimbus accepts) — expected 2–4 business days for acceptance if account set up in AWS Marketplace
- Week 2–3: GCP private offer creation + buyer acceptance (longer if GCP resellers involved) — plan 5–10 business days
- Week 3–4: Billing activation and first invoice (billing begins on the activation date; 30-day net terms unless otherwise agreed)
- Close target: July 28, 2028 (aligns with your end-of-July ask)

Attachments included: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestone table), SOW-draft.pdf (placeholder). I also flagged a couple of procurement friction points in the sheet: invoice entity mismatch (we can accept invoice to either Nimbus Health Inc. or Nimbus Solutions LLC — confirm), and KMS/HSM key ownership for private deployments (if you require customer-managed keys, that adds a 2–3 week technical validation step).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms invoice entity and PO approver by EOD Wed (6/20)
2) Nimbus legal sends redlines to SOW by Fri (6/22)
3) We submit AWS private offer as soon as SOW is signed (target 6/25–6/28)

Looping in Rishi (billing) and Karthik (SE) to confirm durations and any technical gating items. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that helps speed procurement.

Thanks Priya — quick billing notes from my side: 
- Minimum monthly commitment for private offers is $25k/month for AWS and $20k/month for GCP in our standard commercial lane. We can tier this down for pilot customers to $10k/mo for the first 90 days with approval (I’ll request the pilot concession).
- Invoicing: Marketplace billing via AWS/GCP will show as marketplace charges on Nimbus invoices; we can also issue a direct invoice if you prefer consolidated billing. Consolidated invoice option requires separate merchant-of-record coordination (adds ~1–2 weeks).
- First invoice: If activation occurs in the middle of the calendar month, the first invoice covers the pro-rated remainder of that month plus the following full month (net 30).

I’ll attach a sample invoice stub (aws-private-offer-invoice-stub.csv) for their finance team to review. Priya — if Nimbus confirms they want pilot concession, I’ll start the internal approval path today.
